summary: Unapplied billing credit after console estimate showed coupon but invoice finalized without it
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a $1,250 billing credit shown in the Redwood Console estimate that did not appear on the finalized invoice for billing cycle 2026-02. The console estimate (timestamp 2026-02-28T18:05:22Z) included a promotional coupon line and an automatic warmup credit for kv-cache. The finalized invoice (2026-03-01) shows the kv-cache credit but the coupon credit is missing.
Impact: Customer expected invoice to match console estimate. Result is a higher-than-expected charge and accounting dispute with their finance team. No service impact to inference throughput.
Environment: Dedicated customer deployment (dedicated pool) in us-east, billing handled by Redwood hosted metering pipeline.
Expected behavior: Console estimate should reflect credits that will be applied to final invoice when coupon is valid at estimate time.
Observed behavior: Console estimate showed coupon and reduced provisional total by $1,250; invoice finalized without the coupon credit and produced a $1,250 discrepancy.
Additional context: Customer applied a negotiated coupon via the Console on 2026-02-27; promo appears in console UI and in the estimate snapshot. Customer says they did not revoke the coupon. Customer provided screenshots of console estimate and a copy of the invoice PDF.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Log in to Redwood Console as org admin for NovaSearch Labs
2) Navigate to Billing > Estimates and generate estimate for billing cycle ending 2026-02-28
3) Observe promotional coupon line and provisional credit in the estimate snapshot (amount $1,250)
4) Wait for invoice finalization job (run nightly 2026-03-01T03:00:00Z) and retrieve final invoice PDF
5) Compare estimate snapshot to invoice lines and note coupon credit absent from invoice

comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-12): Opened ticket after customer provided estimate screenshot and invoice PDF. Asking billing team to confirm whether promo was flagged during invoice run.

Diego Morales (Billing Eng) (2026-03-12): Assigned. Initial hypothesis: promo line was present in console estimate cache but promo lookup failed in invoicer due to tag normalization change introduced 2026-02-25 (see linked PR). Will validate promo lookup logs and database state at finalize time.

Customer (Elena Ruiz, NovaSearch Labs) (2026-03-13): We didn't revoke the coupon. Finance is asking for a credit memo if the invoice stands. Happy to provide any logs/screenshots. Important for month-end close.

Diego Morales (2026-03-13): Confirmed promo record exists in promo_audit and active=true. Next step: check invoicer service logs for promo resolution and reconciliation actions. Requested invoice run logs from infra team.

SRE (Jordan Kim) (2026-03-14): Attached invoicer run log snippet: invoicer skipped promo resolution for org-novasearch due to a validation error: 'promo_tag unknown: eco_flag'. This matches a recent tag normalization migration. Continuing investigation.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Console estimate uses a separate promo cache that was populated when coupon created; invoicer does a fresh promo lookup at invoice time and failed due to tag normalization mismatch introduced by PR #478 which renamed 'sustainability' to 'eco_flag'.

Hypothesis 2: Promo was accidentally scoped to estimate snapshots only (feature gate regression) and not to final invoice pipeline due to missing feature-flag propagation in production config for dedicated-tier customers.
Queries run: SELECT id, active, scopes, tags FROM promos WHERE id='promo-2026-02-27-NSL'; -- returns active=true, scopes=['invoice','estimate'], tags=['sustainability']
Invoicer log excerpt: 'ERROR promo_resolver: promo tag "sustainability" unknown for org org-novasearch; falling back to no-promo'

Reproduction attempt: Re-ran invoicer's promo resolution function locally with current tag mapping: it failed to map 'sustainability' to 'eco_flag'. Console estimate service maps tags from old->new names on read, invoicer does strict lookup.

Impact assessment: Only affects invoices generated between 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-02 while tag migration was partially deployed. Estimated affected customer subset small but could cause invoice delta for those with promo relying on renamed tags.
Temporary mitigation: Mark promo as having alias tag 'eco_flag' in DB for org-novasearch so invoicer will resolve it during re-run of invoice job.
resolution:
Workaround applied: Billing ops added alias tag 'eco_flag' to promo-2026-02-27-NSL and queued a re-run of the invoicer finalization job for inv-2026-02-NSL. Re-run completed 2026-03-14T11:22:30Z and invoice was regenerated as a credit memo plus replacement invoice: inv-2026-02-NSL-CR (credit memo $1,250) and inv-2026-02-NSL-REISSUE (net total matched console estimate). Customer notified and requested expedited credit posting.
Long-term fix: Prod invoicer will be patched to accept legacy tag aliases or perform tag normalization before lookup. Engineering PR #503 is in review and scheduled for rollout 2026-03-17. Follow-up task created to scan invoices between 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-02 for similar missing promo credits.
Action items: [Billing Ops] ensure credit memo posted and auto-applied; [Engineering] merge PR #503 and roll out; [Support] confirm with customer when credit posts and close ticket.
